description: What the renderer is allowed to ask the host for. Deliberately minimal: this is a capability list, so anything not named here is refused, and Phase 2's filesystem and browser access must be added DELIBERATELY rather than inherited.

permissions.comment: Opening a URL in the SYSTEM browser is the only outbound navigation this app performs, and it is required rather than convenient: navigating the single webview away from the bundle destroys the app until the user force-quits. Scoped to http/https so a page cannot ask the host to launch an arbitrary local handler.
